name: joules
description: Grok plugins for authoring a plugin and for checking a web app.

plugins.name: joules-plugins
plugins.description: Create, evaluate, update, or score one Grok plugin from the current docs and one rubric.

plugins.name: web-app
plugins.description: Create or extend a Void pages app on Cloudflare Workers. A page, a table, or a stream is one addition. The app connects the branches it lists to an automatic validate-build-deploy pipeline without a workflow file, and serves one public HTTP healthcheck.
plugins.author: Joules
